name: TapeOsc
description: Varispeed oscillator with tape motor start/stop. Platform band-limited saw, square, triangle, and sine are written to a tape and slowed down like a deck, with HyperSaw-style unison.

params.name: WAVE
params.detail: Waveform: saw, square, triangle, sine. Uses the logue band-limited tables.

params.name: START
params.detail: Tape motor spin-up time in milliseconds (10-2000)

params.name: STOP
params.detail: Tape motor spin-down time in milliseconds (10-4000)

params.name: GRIT
params.detail: Read-head interpolation. 0 is linear, full is stepped zero-order hold.

params.name: WEAR
params.detail: Lo-fi wear: hiss, saturation, droop, dropouts

params.name: WOW
params.detail: Wow and flutter depth, 0-100%. 100% is about ±10% tape speed.

params.name: UNI
params.detail: Unison voice count, 1-9, with HyperSaw-style crossfade

params.name: DET
params.detail: Detune spread of the unison voices (HyperSaw / Virus curve)
